articles.title: Anthropic unveils 'Claude Science' AI platform for scientific research - Yahoo News Canada
articles.summary_en: Anthropic has introduced 'Claude Science,' a dedicated platform integrating over 60 scientific databases and specialized visualization tools to streamline complex research and data analysis. The platform aims to accelerate scientific workflows by enabling researchers to manage coding, literature review, and 3D protein rendering within a unified, secure workspace.

articles.title: SandboxAQ to bring scientific AI models to Google Cloud Marketplace - MobiHealthNews
articles.summary_en: SandboxAQ is integrating its Large Quantitative Models, including AQCat and AQPotency, into the Google Cloud Marketplace to streamline materials science and drug discovery. By combining these models with Google’s Gemini, researchers can perform complex scientific calculations directly within their existing workflows.

articles.title: Google is launching AI models for science that could cut research time by years - Mezha
articles.summary_en: Google is introducing new AI models specifically engineered for scientific research, with the objective of significantly accelerating discovery timelines by years.

articles.title: US government allows Anthropic limited release of AI model that sparked cybersecurity concerns - Egypt Independent
articles.summary_en: The US government has authorized Anthropic to provide select cybersecurity partners with access to its 'Mythos 5' model after implementing safety safeguards to mitigate national security risks. This decision partially reverses a recent export ban that had restricted the model due to concerns over its potential to rapidly identify and exploit software vulnerabilities.

articles.title: Governor Newsom announces a first-of-its-kind partnership, providing Anthropic tools to state agencies and improving services for Californians | Governor of California - California State Portal | CA.gov
articles.summary_en: California has partnered with Anthropic to provide state agencies, cities, and counties with access to the Claude AI assistant at a 50% discount. The initiative includes free workforce training and technical support to improve government efficiency in areas like document analysis, cyber defense, and customer service.

articles.title: AWS builds new partner strategy around agentic AI outcomes - ChannelE2E
articles.summary_en: AWS has launched a 'Business Value Realization' (BVR) program that ties partner incentives and funding to verified customer outcomes rather than project completion milestones. This strategy reflects a broader market shift where 80% of customers now demand outcome-based commercial models to ensure AI investments deliver measurable business results.

articles.title: AI agents that provide ‘economic value’ are next frontier, says Meta AI research chief - South China Morning Post
articles.summary_en: Meta’s new AI research lead, Dawn Song, aims to shift the industry focus toward building AI agents capable of performing economically valuable, real-world tasks. This effort is supported by UC Berkeley’s new ‘Agents’ Last Exam’ benchmark, which evaluates agent performance across over 1,500 complex tasks in 55 different industries.

articles.title: US allows partial release of Anthropic's Mythos AI model - dw.com
articles.summary_en: The U.S. government has partially lifted its ban on Anthropic's Claude Mythos 5 model, granting access to select cybersecurity firms tasked with protecting critical infrastructure. This decision follows weeks of tension over the administration's strict oversight and concerns regarding potential misuse of frontier AI models by foreign military intelligence.

articles.title: Google DeepMind strikes AI research deal with A24 - IBC.org
articles.summary_en: Google DeepMind has entered into a strategic research partnership with independent film studio A24, involving a reported $75 million investment. The collaboration aims to co-develop AI-driven creative workflows and production tools, reflecting a broader industry trend of Hollywood studios integrating generative AI to streamline filmmaking processes.

articles.title: Trump admin allows Anthropic to release Mythos AI model to some companies, government agencies - CNBC
articles.summary_en: The U.S. government has granted Anthropic limited permission to deploy its Mythos 5 model to approximately 100 federal agencies and corporate partners. This decision marks a partial breakthrough in the ongoing standoff between Anthropic and the administration, although access to the company's Fable 5 model remains suspended due to national security concerns.
